pv_hook: Second place is on the line. Here's the analysis.
pv_stake: Spain lead the group on six points. England and Croatia have three each, so this is a straight fight for second.
Only the top two go through. And after a UEFA sanction, only about 6,000 children and 100 England fans are allowed in.
pv_players: For Croatia, captain Luka Modrić, who became their oldest scorer at 41 against Czechia, and Joško Gvardiol.
For England, captain Harry Kane, with 87 goals for his country, and Anthony Gordon, who has scored in three England games in a row.
pv_tactics: Croatia are expected in a 4-2-3-1, with Modrić and Kovačić in midfield. Against Spain, they managed only five shots.
England also go 4-2-3-1, with Kane up front. Against Czechia, they had 22 shots and kept their first clean sheet in seven games.
pv_expect: Expect England on the ball, and Croatia compact, with Modrić pulling the strings.
The duel to watch: Bellingham against Modrić.
England won 4-2 when these two met at the World Cup in June. Our read: England unbeaten, in a tight game.
pv_round: Also in this group, world champions Spain host Czechia in Oviedo. Spain are unbeaten in 40 games.
Czechia have lost both games so far. Our read: a big Spain win.
In League B, leaders Switzerland host Slovenia in Lucerne, without Xhaka and Embolo.
Slovenia are yet to concede, but they're missing Šeško. Our read: Switzerland, by two or more.
And in Skopje, North Macedonia host Scotland. Andy Robertson is set for his 100th cap.
Neither side has won yet. Our read: Scotland avoid defeat, in a low-scoring game.
pv_cta: That's the analysis. Follow for more football, by the numbers.

pv_cold.say: And today, only a hundred England fans are allowed in.
